def rgb_to_hsv(r, g, b):
    r /= 255.0
    g /= 255.0
    b /= 255.0

    max_color = max(r, g, b)
    min_color = min(r, g, b)

    if max_color == min_color:
        h = 0
    elif max_color == r:
        h = (60 * ((g - b) / (max_color - min_color))) % 360
    elif max_color == g:
        h = (60 * ((b - r) / (max_color - min_color)) + 120) % 360
    else:
        h = (60 * ((r - g) / (max_color - min_color)) + 240) % 360

    s = (max_color - min_color) / max_color if max_color != 0 else 0
    v = max_color

    return h, s, v
```
